stories.title: Profile API
stories.description: Adds GET /api/profile returning ProfileDto from portal/api/ProfileController.cs. Needs Q-2 merged first because it reuses the avatar store that Q-2 introduces.

stories.title: Avatar store
stories.description: Introduce the avatar blob store in portal/storage/AvatarStore.cs and show the avatar in the profile header.

stories.title: Avatar cropping
stories.description: Builds on Q-2: let employees crop the avatar before saving, in portal/profile/Crop.tsx.

stories.title: Timesheet submit API
stories.description: Adds POST /api/timesheets accepting TimesheetDto in portal/api/TimesheetController.cs.

stories.title: Timesheet entry page
stories.description: The weekly entry page portal/timesheets/Entry.tsx calls POST /api/timesheets. Tests use the fixture tests/fixtures/timesheets.json.

stories.title: Mobile timesheet submit
stories.description: The mobile app screen mobile/timesheets/Submit.tsx calls POST /api/timesheets.

stories.title: Overtime field on timesheets
stories.description: Extends TimesheetDto with an overtimeHours field in portal/api/dto/TimesheetDto.cs.

stories.title: Timesheet approval tests
stories.description: Add approval scenarios to the fixture tests/fixtures/timesheets.json and to tests/approval/ApprovalTests.cs.

stories.title: Dark mode
stories.description: Add a dark theme in portal/theme/dark.css with a toggle in the settings menu.

stories.title: Help page
stories.description: Static help page portal/help/Help.tsx with links to the HR policies.
